measures.attendance: Human-verified voluntary check-ins, separate from accounts
measures.completion_rate: completed cases / started cases; null when no starts
measures.mean_solve_seconds: Mean final-solve timestamp minus first-open timestamp for completed cases only; includes pauses
measures.confidence_change: Mean paired post-pre self-report; specify retrospective or prospective
measures.universities: Distinct voluntary nonempty strings; human normalization required

privacy.retention: Organizer sets and communicates a deletion date before collection
